title: Daily AI
intro: Five questions about this corner of the internet. Choose one and my homelab generates an answer live, using a local model and public sources from this site.
policy: One question per IP per day, resetting at midnight Beijing time. You can reopen the same answer afterward. Shared networks share an allowance.
aiNotice: These answers are generated by AI, are written in English, and may be inaccurate. Check the linked sources.
banPolicy: This feature permanently bans IPs that send malformed AI requests or use curl/Python user agents. Bans can be removed by the site owner.
pending: The homelab is offline or unavailable. Please come back later.
banned: This IP is banned from Daily AI. Contact the site owner if you need the ban reviewed.
limit: This IP has already chosen a question today. Refresh to reopen its answer.
trafficLimit: Too many requests. Please wait a minute before trying again.
timeout: The request timed out. Refresh to check whether your selection was accepted.
fullSite: Open the full site to choose a question
generationFailed: Generation stopped or the connection was interrupted. You can retry a failed generation.
thinkingNotice: Generated by the local model and shown as received. This may contain mistakes and does not verify the answer.
